summary: The registrant, AVAX ONE TECHNOLOGY LTD., filed a Form 8-K under Item 8.01 solely to announce the posting of a new investor presentation to its website. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or abrupt management change is described. The filing is a routine current report updating investors about a presentation; it does not trigger any special-situations classification.
